question.prompt: Six trees are equally spaced along one side of a straight road. The distance from the first tree to the fourth is \(60\) feet. What is the distance in feet between the first and last trees?

solutions.explanation:
Equal spacing suggests counting the gaps between trees. From the first tree to the fourth there are \(3\) gaps, so each gap measures
\[
60\div3=20\text{ feet}.
\]
From the first tree to the sixth and last tree there are \(5\) gaps. Thus the distance is
\[
5\times20=100\text{ feet},
\]
choice B.
solutions.title: Count the spaces between trees
